resources.string: The calories are for the drink as brewed, from USDA FoodData Central: black tea and coffee, an espresso, matcha whisked in water, and a cappuccino made with reduced-fat milk — with whole milk it is about a fifth more. Milk, cream, sugar and syrup added at the table come on top and are logged as food. A cappuccino is saved as food with its caffeine: its calories count in the day’s food, but it does not count as a meal. The other cups come to a few calories and stay a caffeine record only.
